n_states_rationale: The action stream reveals six distinct functional goals across all sessions: filling the water tank, preparing the coffee machine and inserting a capsule, frothing milk, brewing or running the coffee, assembling the final drink by combining coffee and milk, and cleaning up the equipment.

states.name: fill water tank
states.definition: Retrieving the water jug, filling the tank with water, and placing the water tank back onto the coffee machine.

states.name: load coffee capsule
states.definition: Opening the coffee machine compartment, inserting a coffee capsule, and locking the handle down.

states.name: froth milk
states.definition: Opening the milk bottle, pouring milk into the milk frother, and running the frother.

states.name: brew coffee
states.definition: Placing a mug under the nozzle and pressing the button on the coffee machine to brew the coffee.

states.name: assemble final drink
states.definition: Pouring the frothed milk into the mug with coffee and stirring the mixture with a wooden stirrer.

states.name: clean equipment
states.definition: Rinsing the milk frother and discarding used stirrers or capsules into the trash bin.

_leak_check.note: recipe steps were NOT provided to the LLM; this compares the independently-derived state count against the card after the fact.
